p0: CHANGE ONLY: the last dumpling sits alone on the centre plate. All three people keep polite smiles but their eyes are all turned down at the dumpling, secretly; the team leader's eyebrows are slightly raised, the assistant manager's lips are pressed together, the new employee swallows. Mongle also stares at the dumpling with bright, hungry eyes.
p1: CHANGE ONLY: the TEAM LEADER leans back cheerfully, patting his round belly with one hand and waving the other hand over the table as if saying 'did everyone eat a lot?', smiling broadly — but his eyes still flick down to the last dumpling. The other two smile and nod politely. Mongle looks at the team leader. The dumpling is still on the plate.
p2: CHANGE ONLY: the ASSISTANT MANAGER waves one hand in front of her chest politely as if saying 'oh no, I'm full', with a modest smile — but her eyes glance sideways down at the last dumpling. The others look at her. The dumpling is still on the plate.
p3: CHANGE ONLY: the NEW EMPLOYEE nods quickly and lifts his barley-tea cup to his lips as if to say 'me too', pretending to drink — but his eyes peek over the cup at the last dumpling. The team leader and assistant manager smile politely. The dumpling is still on the plate.
p4: CHANGE ONLY: MONGLE perks up with sparkling round eyes, a big happy open smile and a blush, its whole body leaning forward toward the last dumpling, as if saying 'then I'll have it!'. The three people, still smiling politely, have not noticed yet. The dumpling is still on the plate.
p5: CHANGE ONLY: MONGLE has stretched its whole soft body forward across the table and gobbled the last dumpling straight off the plate with its mouth — Mongle's cheek bulges round and full, a few crumbs on the now EMPTY centre plate; Mongle's eyes are closed in happy arcs. The three people's eyes go wide in shock, mouths small 'o'. The dumpling is NOT visible anywhere — it is inside Mongle's bulging cheek.
p6: CHANGE ONLY: total awkward silence. Mongle sits back on its cushion on the right, chewing happily with one round bulging cheek and closed happy eyes, completely unaware. The three people are FROZEN staring at Mongle with blank, stunned faces: the team leader's glasses slightly crooked and his mouth a flat line, the assistant manager's mouth a tiny 'o', the new employee with one sweat drop. The centre plate is EMPTY.
p7: CHANGE ONLY: the ASSISTANT MANAGER leans far to the right toward Mongle, one hand cupped beside her mouth, whispering urgently with a strained smile and worried eyebrows. Mongle, its cheek still slightly bulging, looks at her with wide round eyes. The team leader and new employee pretend to look elsewhere awkwardly. The centre plate is EMPTY.
p8: CHANGE ONLY: MONGLE tilts its whole body to one side, puzzled: eyes wide round dots, mouth a small wavy line, as if asking 'nunchi…?'. The assistant manager covers her face with one hand, embarrassed; the team leader scratches his cheek awkwardly; the new employee stares at Mongle. The centre plate is EMPTY.
p9: CHANGE ONLY: the TEAM LEADER bursts out laughing with crinkled eyes and raises one hand high toward the side of the room as if calling the staff for one more plate. The assistant manager and new employee laugh with relief. Mongle smiles sheepishly with a blush. The centre plate is EMPTY.
p10: CHANGE ONLY: some time later — the centre plate again holds exactly ONE last steamed dumpling (the same kind). This time all three people turn their eyes at MONGLE at the same moment with knowing, teasing smiles, as if testing it. Mongle stiffens.
p11: CHANGE ONLY: the centre plate holds exactly ONE last steamed dumpling. MONGLE looks away from the dumpling to the side with its eyes squeezed shut, a polite sheepish smile, a big sweat drop, its body leaning slightly back away from the plate — as if saying 'I… I'm full'. The three people look at Mongle in surprise.
p12: CHANGE ONLY: the centre plate holds exactly ONE last steamed dumpling. All three people laugh warmly at Mongle — the team leader gives Mongle a thumbs up, the assistant manager claps, the new employee laughs with crinkled eyes. Mongle beams proudly with closed happy-arc eyes and a big blush.
